en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Dialogue between a boy (Gjorgji) and a girl (Stojna) who refuses to elope because she has linen to bleach. The last two lines are my reading: the boy says to leave the chore to her mother.

lines.en: - Come on, come on, maiden Stojna,

lines.cyr: ајде, ајде, моме Стојне да бегаме.
lines.lat: ajde, ajde, mome Stojne da begame.
lines.en: come on, come on, maiden Stojna, let's run away.
- I am not a girl for running away,

lines.cyr: не сум мома, либе Ѓорѓи, за бегање.
lines.lat: ne sum moma, libe Ǵorǵi, za beganje.
lines.en: I am not a girl, dear Gjorgji, for running away.

lines.cyr: имам платно, либе Ѓорѓи, за белење.
lines.lat: imam platno, libe Ǵorǵi, za belenje.
lines.en: I have linen, dear Gjorgji, for bleaching.

lines.cyr: остави го, моме Стојне, на мајка ти.
lines.lat: ostavi go, mome Stojne, na majka ti.
lines.en: leave it, maiden Stojna, to your mother.
Let her cry, let her bleach,

lines.cyr: ем да плаче, моме Стојне, ем да бели.
lines.lat: em da plače, mome Stojne, em da beli.
lines.en: both let her cry, maiden Stojna, and let her bleach.
